Q5171.reason: Once out of controlled cold storage a unit should be started within 30 minutes; the 4-hour limit is for finishing the transfusion, and room-temperature blood is not safe for half a day.

Q5966.reason: Standard physiology defines the cardiac cycle as diastole and systole only; contraction is systole and any resting interval is part of diastole, not a third phase.

Q8473.reason: Hektoen enteric agar is selective for Salmonella and Shigella, so a positive culture indicates Salmonella typhi; C. difficile and intestinal protozoa are not recovered on it.
